description: SASRec predicts the next item using causal self-attention over a user's interaction history. Item and position embeddings pass through attention and feed-forward blocks; the resulting features score candidate items by dot product. Training uses shifted sequences and sampled-negative binary cross-entropy. [Paper](https://arxiv.org/html/1808.09781). The supplied idea establishes a RecHarness baseline; it specifies no new cold-start mechanism.
motivation: Attention lets the model focus on relevant recent interactions while retaining access to longer histories. This supports recommendation across datasets with different interaction densities. SASRec alone does not resolve recommendation for entirely unseen items or users without histories. [Source](https://arxiv.org/abs/1808.09781).
implementation_notes: Start from RecHarness sasrec_perdataset and preserve all four category routes. Use preprocessing seed 0, training seed 42, DATA_DIR=os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'], trial-local artifacts, single-GPU execution, and the environment default SASREC_EPOCHS=200. Select using macro validation HR@10 under the pinned evaluator; no task-specific improvement is established yet. Preserve DiagnosisProbe(view, device).run_full_diagnosis(train_loader), its metrics and metric_definitions outputs, and the SASRec compatibility interface. Any architecture change must also update the predictor writer. Use only permitted public data and keep all search work within 43,200 GPU-seconds.
pseudocode: For each category: load the unchanged benchmark split; construct padded history prefixes and next-item targets; sample negatives; encode prefixes with causally masked SASRec; optimize positive and negative prediction loss. Compare trials using the host's macro validation HR@10. Save selected category checkpoints and emit working/predict.py with matching architecture and dataset routing.

originality.positive: Provides a controlled application of SASRec to the specified four-category benchmark.
originality.negative: The supplied description introduces no architectural innovation or explicit cold-start treatment.

future_potential.negative: Such an extension remains hypothetical and requires validation within the shared search budget.
